clauses.reason: Whole order (single operative paragraph): suspends section 6374 of title 10 only for the described class of Marine Corps brigadier generals, until June 29, 1968. Terminated by its own terms, recorded as 1968-06-29 inclusive; the exclusive reading is that it ends when that day begins. No amendment, extension or revocation is held, so there is no earlier end.

research_rationale:
EO 11333 (March 7, 1967, signed by Lyndon B. Johnson, printed at 32 FR 3879), Partially suspending section 6374 of Title 10 of the United States Code, relating to retirement of brigadier generals of the Marine Corps, read in full in the registered Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11333.txt (machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF, graded original_representation_unverified and counted as an official original; number, title and date agree with the census register; I did not inspect the PDF page images). Content: under section 6386(c) of title 10 of the United States Code the order suspends, until June 29, 1968, the provisions of section 6374 of title 10, but only with respect to a brigadier general on the active list of the Marine Corps whose second failure of selection for promotion to major general occurred during the same fiscal year as his first failure. First end: by its own terms the suspension runs until June 29, 1968. Under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on until dates it is recorded as 1968-06-29, inclusive (the suspension runs through the end of that day); the exclusive reading is that the suspension ends when June 29, 1968 begins. After the suspension lapses, section 6374 applies again to that class of officers by its own force. Later events: none found. Three selected machine searches: U.S. Code and eCFR have no hit; the Federal Register order catalog has one hit, an editorial note that the suspension was good only until the same date, which agrees with the order own terms and is a lead and not a separate ending. A citation search of the 33,118 held order texts under jobs/*/output/texts (clause-drafts excluded) for the forms Executive Order 11333, Order No. 11333 and E.O. 11333 finds only the order own capture; the held text of EO 12553 (51 FR 7237) does not print the number 11333 in its table. No held extension of the suspension was found. The standing disclosure that this order rests on a Federal Register OCR text layer and not on an authenticated original applies.

savings.reason: The order has no savings or transition language. The suspension affected whether the statutory retirement rule applied to the named class of brigadier generals while it ran; once it lapsed on June 29, 1968 the statute operates on its own terms, and nothing in the order preserves the suspension for any person after that date.
